name: China Western Power Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1983 and headquartered in Zigong, China Western Power Industrial Co., Ltd. specializes in the engineering, manufacturing, and distribution of a wide array of boilers and pressure vessels within China. Their product portfolio encompasses diverse types such as coal-fired utility, waste-to-energy, biomass power generation, gas, oil-silt, industrial, and specialized boilers, including environmental protection, alkali recovery, BFG, and HRSG units. Beyond product offerings, the company delivers comprehensive engineering, site management for installations, and financial services. These services span critical areas like new and smart energy solutions, environmental protection, intelligent urban infrastructure (smart cities, roads, transportation), and waste management (including gas, liquor, and solid waste). Additionally, China Western Power actively participates in the investment, construction, and operation of Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) initiatives, and directly invests in and operates power plants.
